  time = 0
  n, m, rb, cb, rd, cd = testcase
  if rb == rd or cb == cd: return 0
  if rb < rd: r = rd-rb
  if rb > rd: r = 2*(n-rb)+rb-rd
  if cb < cd: c = cd - cb
  if cb > cd: c = 2*(m-cb)+cb-cd
  return min(r,c)
